collectible:1.text: Flying Rats are a collectible in Grand Theft Auto IV. There are 200 pigeons located all around Liberty City and Alderney, which the player must find and either shoot, burn, blow up, or run down with a vehicle. The pigeons are generally found in remote areas, and can be noticed by their distinctive cooing and the red glow they're highlighted with (making them easier to spot at night).

collectible:2.text: Unique Stunt Jumps (also known as Unique Jumps in 3D Universe and Stunt Jumps in GTA IV) are a feature in every Grand Theft Auto game since GTA III (with the exception of GTA Advance). All GTA games have jumps set up around their maps for "insane" stunting.

easter-egg:2.text: Burger Shot (formerly The Burger Shot) is a chain of hamburger fast-food restaurants in the 3D Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series. The chain is also featured in Rockstar North's Manhunt series. Burger Shot first appeared in the form of "The Burger Shot," a small restaurant in GTA Vice City (among many other less known outlets in the Game) where the player can replenish their health if it is below 100 points.

easter-egg:4.text: Cash Registers are static objects in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories, Grand Theft Auto IV, Episodes from Liberty City, Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online. Cash registers first appear in GTA Vice City, but are non-interactive, as the player commits robberies by aiming a weapon at the shopkeeper.

easter-egg:6.text: Mikhail Faustin's Mansion was the residence of the Faustin family in Grand Theft Auto IV, Episodes from Liberty City and Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars. It is located in Beachgate, Broker, Liberty City. The sumptuous mansion is located on Shinnecock Avenue. It was the residence of Mikhail Faustin, Ilyena Faustin and Anna Faustin until Mikhail's death.

easter-egg:8.text: The Brute Mr Tasty is a frozen foods truck appearing in Grand Theft Auto IV. The overall design of the truck resembles a 1998 Chevrolet P30 Ice Cream Truck. Replacing the Mr Whoopee van from the 3D Universe, the Mr Tasty is a large van tailored to carry and sell ice cream.

easter-egg:9.text: Outlook Park is a public park in Grand Theft Auto IV, Episodes from Liberty City and Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars in Outlook, Broker, Liberty City. It is bounded to the north by Earp Street, to the east by Montauk Avenue, to the south by Gibson Street, and to the west by Oneida Avenue. It is the largest park in Broker and features in the Soak In The Sights section of Peep That Shit.

easter-egg:11.page: Weazelnews.com/Patriotic Police Can't be Charged with Brutality
easter-egg:11.text: Patriotic Police Can't be Charged with Brutality is a newspaper article on the Weazel News website of Grand Theft Auto IV. The article was written by John Chesapeake and published in 2008. It is available to read via internet after the completion of the mission Hung Out to Dry.

easter-egg:13.text: The Statue of Happiness is a statue appearing in Grand Theft Auto IV, The Lost and Damned, The Ballad of Gay Tony, and Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars. Located on Happiness Island in Liberty City, it is clearly based on the Statue of Liberty in New York City.

easter-egg:14.text: The Liberty City War Memorial is a commemorative statue that appears in Grand Theft Auto III and Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories. The monuments commemorate an unspecified armed conflict that occurred in 1936. It is located opposite Francis International Airport, outside the Shoreside Terminal. This monument is a statue of a kneeling soldier holding a flag, comedically featuring a traffic cone on its head.

easter-egg:17.text: The 3D Universe Tribute Graffiti is an Easter egg appearing in Grand Theft Auto IV and Episodes from Liberty City. Inside multiple apartment building interiors in Liberty City and Alderney, a graffiti paying tribute to several deceased people can be found painted on walls.

easter-egg:18.text: Babies Overnight (babiesovernight.com) is a website that is accessible through the Internet in Grand Theft Auto IV. The website is a reference to the Pets Overnight website from Grand Theft Auto III, as both sites have similar names, premises and taglines.

easter-egg:20.text: Claude's Outfit is the primary outfit featured in Grand Theft Auto III and an optional outfit featured in Grand Theft Auto IV and Grand Theft Auto Online. The default outfit for the protagonist Claude is the iconic black bomber leather jacket, dark green cargo pants, and blue sneakers.

easter-egg:22.text: Funland Miniature Golf is a miniature golf course in Grand Theft Auto IV, Episodes from Liberty City and Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars located in Firefly Island, Broker, Liberty City. The minigolf is located in the Funland amusement park. The kiosk advertises an Ocean or Beach 9-hole course; however, only one course is present in the game.

easter-egg:23.text: The Space Monkey Street Artist is a minor character in Grand Theft Auto V. The artist is a marketing intern for the makers of the Space Monkey 3D movie. The artist appears in the monkey mosaic random event after the player has photographed all of his previous mosaic paintings, making one of his Monkey Mosaics near the Los Santos Customs in Burton.

easter-egg:24.text: Donald Love is a main character in Grand Theft Auto III, a minor character in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, and the tritagonist of Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories. He is also mentioned in Grand Theft Auto Advance. He is voiced by Kyle MacLachlan in GTA III, Cam Neely in GTA Vice City and Will Janowitz in GTA Liberty City Stories.

easter-egg:25.text: Gruppe Sechs (German for group six, also written as gruppe 6) is a private security company and riot control service appearing in the HD Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series. Starting with Grand Theft Auto IV, the company's logo reads as "Gruppe 6", although "Gruppe Sechs" is still written in smaller print on the company's vehicles.

easter-egg:27.text: Love Fist is a Scottish heavy metal band in the HD Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series, first mentioned in Grand Theft Auto IV and Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars. A single member of the band, Willie, also appears in Grand Theft Auto V. Artworks and memorabilia of the band appear in Grand Theft Auto Online.

easter-egg:28.text: HALO is a Parachuting job featured in Grand Theft Auto Online. It is available for up to 4 players. The players jump from a helicopter above the Los Santos International Airport and descent rapidly through four checkpoints, before landing on a taxiway.

easter-egg:29.text: Manhunt is a stealth, horror-survival videogame duology developed by Rockstar North and published by Rockstar Games. The first game, Manhunt, was originally released for the PlayStation 2 on November 18, 2003.

easter-egg:30.text: Mario Venturella is a character who is mentioned in Grand Theft Auto IV. Mario Venturella is the current lover of Don Mary Valvona, the head of the Pavano Family. Venturella is a cat burglar based in Algonquin, Liberty City, and is suspected by the LCPD to be involved in a series of burglaries in Middle Park East.

easter-egg:31.text: Mortal Sin is a video game for the portable console EXsorbeo, mentioned in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. The game is advertised on the EXsorbeo official site.

easter-egg:33.text: Concrete Jungle is a mission in Grand Theft Auto IV given to protagonist Niko Bellic by Jamaican gangster "Little" Jacob Hughes from his apartment in Schottler, Broker, Liberty City. This mission introduces the player to the Cover System as well as the use of the Pump Shotgun. Real Badman's crew are looking to buy product from a new source so they can sell it around their territory.

easter-egg:34.page: Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend
easter-egg:34.text: Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend is a mission in Grand Theft Auto IV given to protagonist Niko Bellic by Irish gangster Gerald McReary from the Alderney State Correctional Facility in Acter Industrial Park, Alderney. In this mission, Niko Bellic and Packie McReary arrange a deal on Charge Island to exchange their hostage, Gracie Ancelotti, for a ransom of diamonds.
